dialogue.content: こんにちわ。１１時になりましたら開始しても大丈夫ですか？
dialogue.English: Hello. Would it be alright if we start at 11:00?

dialogue.content: こんにちは。お疲れ様です。本日はよろしくお願いいたします。はい、大丈夫です。
dialogue.English: Hello. Thank you for seeing me today. Yes, that's fine.

dialogue.content: 宜しくお願いします。
dialogue.English: I look forward to working with you.

dialogue.content: 時間になりましたので始めさせていただきますね。今日はどの様なご相談ですか？
dialogue.English: It's time, so let's begin. What would you like to discuss today?

dialogue.content: はい。就職活動が上手くいかなくて
dialogue.English: Yes. My job search isn't going well,

dialogue.content: 悩んでいます
dialogue.English: and I'm struggling with it.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね、就職活動がうまくいかないのですね
dialogue.English: I see—your job search isn't going well.

dialogue.content: はい。全然
dialogue.English: Yes, not at all.

dialogue.content: どのように上手くいかないのか聞かせてもらえますか？
dialogue.English: Could you tell me more about how it's not going well?

dialogue.content: 色々とエントリーしたり面接したりしてるのですが、なかなか進まないんです
dialogue.English: I've been applying for various positions and have had interviews, but I'm just not making any progress.

dialogue.content: 中々進まないのはいきづまってしまいますよね
dialogue.English: Not making progress can really make you feel stuck, can't it?

dialogue.content: はい、周りで決まってる子もいるのに、、、
dialogue.English: Yes, especially when some people around me have already gotten offers...

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Mmmhmm.

dialogue.content: 自分はなんでなんやろって
dialogue.English: I wonder why it's not happening for me,

dialogue.content: 焦ります
dialogue.English: and it makes me anxious.

dialogue.content: ええ、焦りますよね
dialogue.English: Yes, I can understand why you'd feel anxious.

dialogue.content: はい、焦ってます
dialogue.English: Yes, I'm anxious.

dialogue.content: 面接した時はどんな気持ちだったですか？
dialogue.English: How did you feel during your interviews?

dialogue.content: 絶対受かってやるって頑張りました
dialogue.English: I did my best, determined to get an offer.

dialogue.content: でも
dialogue.English: But...

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Mmmhmm.

dialogue.content: 言いたいことも全部言って
dialogue.English: I said everything I wanted to say,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: いけたと思ったのに
dialogue.English: and I thought it went really well, but...

dialogue.content: そうですよね
dialogue.English: I can imagine.

dialogue.content: なぜか全部落ちるんです
dialogue.English: but for some reason, I get rejected every time.

dialogue.content: 落ちるのはショックです。面接の人から言われて何かショックなこととかありましたか？
dialogue.English: Getting rejected is a shock. Did the interviewers say anything that was particularly upsetting?

dialogue.content: いや、ショックなことは特になかったのですが、
dialogue.English: No, there wasn't anything particularly shocking, but...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: でも割と手ごたえあったと思っただけに逆に
dialogue.English: but on the contrary, precisely because I felt I had made a good impression,

dialogue.content: なんでというか
dialogue.English: it just makes me wonder why.

dialogue.content: 人が信じられなくなりそうというか
dialogue.English: It's like I'm starting to lose trust in people.

dialogue.content: はい、そうですよね
dialogue.English: Yes, that's understandable.

dialogue.content: 何が原因なのか聞きたいですよね
dialogue.English: You want to know what the cause is, don't you?

dialogue.content: そうなんです。じぶんの何が悪いのか
dialogue.English: Exactly. What's wrong with me?

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Mmmhmm.

dialogue.content: 正直周りの子よりも
dialogue.English: Honestly, compared to the others around me,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 絶対自分の方が頑張ってるのに
dialogue.English: I'm definitely working harder, and yet...

dialogue.content: なのに
dialogue.English: And yet...

dialogue.content: なんでなん！？って、、、
dialogue.English: I just keep thinking, 'Why?!'

dialogue.content: 凄く頑張ってるからこそ悔しい気持ちは倍以上ですよね
dialogue.English: Precisely because you're working so hard, the frustration must feel twice as strong.

dialogue.content: はい。しかも結果も出ないし
dialogue.English: Yes. And on top of that, I'm not getting any results,

dialogue.content: なんか自分はダメ人間って言われてる気がする
dialogue.English: it feels like I'm being told that I'm a failure.

dialogue.content: ええ、合否だけですものね
dialogue.English: Yes, it all just boils down to pass or fail, doesn't it?

dialogue.content: はい、絶対自分より
dialogue.English: Yes, someone who definitely...

dialogue.content: サボってた奴がなんで内定出て
dialogue.English: ...slacked off more than me gets an offer,

dialogue.content: 自分は出ないんだって
dialogue.English: and I don't?

dialogue.content: ちなみにどうゆう関係のお仕事か教えていただけますか？
dialogue.English: If you don't mind my asking, what field of work are you applying for?

dialogue.content: 一応興味のあるところは色々受けてます
dialogue.English: I've been applying to various places that I'm interested in.

dialogue.content: 旅行関係、出版関係
dialogue.English: The travel and publishing industries,

dialogue.content: あとは大手のメーカーとかですね、
dialogue.English: and also major manufacturers, things like that.

dialogue.content: おお！！すごいですね！
dialogue.English: Wow, that's impressive!

dialogue.content: でも、、、やってもやってもダメなので
dialogue.English: But... no matter how hard I try, it's no good.

dialogue.content: くいじけそうになってしまわれているのですね・・
dialogue.English: It sounds like you're on the verge of giving up...

dialogue.content: くじけそうの間違い。すみません
dialogue.English: I meant 'on the verge of giving up.' My apologies.

dialogue.content: はい、人も自分も信じられなくなってきています
dialogue.English: Yes, I'm starting to lose faith in others and in myself.

dialogue.content: いったい何が？？とおもいますよね
dialogue.English: You must be wondering, 'What on earth is happening?' right?

dialogue.content: そうなんです。そもそも
dialogue.English: Exactly. In the first place,

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Mmmhmm.

dialogue.content: 大学入ってからずっと色々頑張ってきたのに
dialogue.English: I've worked so hard at so many things since I started university, and yet...

dialogue.content: なんか適当に授業受けてる人が先に
dialogue.English: people who were just coasting through their classes are the first to...

dialogue.content: ええ、一生懸命勉強されてきたのは伝わりますのも。
dialogue.English: Yes, I can tell that you've been studying so diligently.

dialogue.content: サクッと内定もらうなんてなんか理不尽ですよね、
dialogue.English: get job offers so easily. It feels so unfair, doesn't it?

dialogue.content: 理不尽とおもいますよね
dialogue.English: It does feel unfair, doesn't it?

dialogue.content: はい。不公平です
dialogue.English: Yes. It's unfair.

dialogue.content: 何が違うのだろうとおもいますよね
dialogue.English: It makes you wonder what the difference is, doesn't it?

dialogue.content: はい、絶対自分採った方がいいのに！
dialogue.English: Yes! They would absolutely be better off hiring me!

dialogue.content: でもなんで、、、
dialogue.English: But why...?

dialogue.content: 素晴らしいお気持ちをお持ちです。
dialogue.English: You have a wonderful attitude.

dialogue.content: どうなんですかねでも結果出ないですからね、、、
dialogue.English: I don't know about that... I'm still not getting any results...

dialogue.content: 自信なくして、全く違う職種に落とされる人が多い中
dialogue.English: Many people lose confidence and end up settling for a completely different type of job, but...

dialogue.content: 悔しい！！自分の方がと思うお気持ちは
dialogue.English: that feeling of frustration, of thinking 'I'm the better choice!'...

dialogue.content: 自分の方がいいと思うお気持ちはとても勇気のある強さを感じました
dialogue.English: that belief that you are the better candidate shows a very courageous strength.

dialogue.content: 一生懸命されてきたからこそなのかなと思いました
dialogue.English: I believe it's precisely because you've worked so hard.

dialogue.content: そうだといいんですけどねでも結局今のところ社会から認められているのは他の子なので
dialogue.English: I'd like to think so, but in the end, the ones being recognized by society right now are the other people.

dialogue.content: 現実はそうですね。でも簡単に就職された方がその職場で
dialogue.English: That is the reality, yes. But for those who get jobs easily,

dialogue.content: 果たして続くのかな？とか活躍するのかな？とか
dialogue.English: I wonder if they'll really last in that workplace, or if they'll even thrive.

dialogue.content: 思ってしまいます
dialogue.English: I can't help but wonder.

dialogue.content: 確かにそれはそうですね
dialogue.English: That's a good point.

dialogue.content: でも今は
dialogue.English: But right now,

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Mmmhmm.

dialogue.content: 内定欲しいです
dialogue.English: I just want a job offer.

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: Of course.

dialogue.content: 周りに取り残された気もするし
dialogue.English: I feel like I'm being left behind by everyone,

dialogue.content: 友達と会う時もなんか気まずいというか
dialogue.English: and it's kind of awkward when I see my friends.

dialogue.content: 情けないというか
dialogue.English: I feel pathetic,

dialogue.content: 恥ずかしいというか
dialogue.English: and ashamed.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Mmmhmm.

dialogue.content: 負けた気がする
dialogue.English: I feel like I've lost.

dialogue.content: とりあえず何処でもいいから内定したいと思われますか？
dialogue.English: Do you feel like you'd take an offer from anywhere at this point?

dialogue.content: いや、流石にどこでもいいとは思わないです
dialogue.English: No, I wouldn't go so far as to say just anywhere would be fine.

dialogue.content: やりたい職種のなかで、あなたの、
dialogue.English: Among the jobs you want to pursue,

dialogue.content: 一生懸命真面目に取り組むその姿勢を
dialogue.English: I hope that your earnest and hardworking attitude...

dialogue.content: 面接官にどうか伝わって欲しいとおもうのですが・・
dialogue.English: somehow gets across to the interviewers.

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: Yes, I wish it would.

dialogue.content: 自分でも面接頑張って
dialogue.English: I try my best in my interviews,

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Mmmhmm.

dialogue.content: 一生懸命話しているし
dialogue.English: and I speak earnestly,

dialogue.content: 面接官も聞いているから
dialogue.English: and the interviewers seem to be listening,

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Right.

dialogue.content: これはいいだろうと
dialogue.English: so I think to myself, 'This is going well.'

dialogue.content: グループ面接でも
dialogue.English: Even in group interviews,

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Mmmhmm.

dialogue.content: 他の人よりいっぱい話して
dialogue.English: I talk more than the other candidates,

dialogue.content: 内容もしっかりしてるのに
dialogue.English: and what I say has substance, and yet...

dialogue.content: でもダメ、、、
dialogue.English: it's still no good.

dialogue.content: 悔しいですね
dialogue.English: That must be so frustrating.

dialogue.content: 一緒に受けてたひとが通る
dialogue.English: The people who interviewed with me get through,

dialogue.content: なんでって、、、
dialogue.English: and I just think, 'Why...?'

dialogue.content: ご自分で、受かる人を見てもしかしてここかな？と思われる所などございますか？
dialogue.English: When you see the people who pass, do you have any inkling as to why it might be?

dialogue.content: いや、それが思い浮かばないんですよ。
dialogue.English: No, that's the thing, I can't think of anything.

dialogue.content: だって
dialogue.English: Because,

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Mmmhmm.

dialogue.content: 業界研究もしっかりして、
dialogue.English: I've done thorough research on the industries,

dialogue.content: マナーとかも勉強して
dialogue.English: I've studied proper etiquette,

dialogue.content: 凄いです
dialogue.English: That's very thorough.

dialogue.content: 学生時代に打ち込んだこともいっぱいあって
dialogue.English: I have plenty of things I was passionate about during my student years,

dialogue.content: それも整理して
dialogue.English: I've organized my thoughts on all of that,

dialogue.content: 面接練習もいっぱいやって
dialogue.English: I've done tons of interview practice,

dialogue.content: しっかり話する準備もしているのに
dialogue.English: and I'm fully prepared to articulate myself well, and yet...

dialogue.content: もしかして、その職場があなたの大きさについていけていない
dialogue.English: Perhaps those companies just can't keep up with someone of your caliber,

dialogue.content: 面接官もあなたの良さに気づいていない
dialogue.English: and the interviewers aren't recognizing your good qualities.

dialogue.content: どうなんでしょうか。
dialogue.English: I wonder if that's the case.

dialogue.content: でも
dialogue.English: But,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 会社って優秀な人を採用したいんじゃないですか？
dialogue.English: don't companies want to hire the most capable people?

dialogue.content: てことは自分はその人より劣ってるのかなって思います
dialogue.English: If so, that must mean I'm inferior to the people they hire.

dialogue.content: 劣っているとは思わないですよ。優秀な面接官だったら、会社をよくしようと思うなら、有望な頑張ってる人を
dialogue.English: I don't think you're inferior at all. A skilled interviewer, if they truly wanted to improve their company, would look for promising, hardworking people...

dialogue.content: しっかり意見を言える人材を求めます
dialogue.English: people who can express their opinions clearly.

dialogue.content: 逆に
dialogue.English: On the other hand,

dialogue.content: 会社の方針にただただ従う人材を求めるならば、もしかしたら、
dialogue.English: if they're just looking for someone who will blindly follow company policy, then perhaps...

dialogue.content: 意見の言えない無難な人を選別されてるんじゃとも思ってしまいましたが、いかが思われますか？
dialogue.English: they might be selecting the 'safe' candidates who won't voice their own opinions. What are your thoughts on that?

dialogue.content: そうなんですかね。ということは自分が受けた会社は全部無難な人を採用する会社ということなんですかね
dialogue.English: Could that be it? Does that mean all the companies I've applied to are the type to hire 'safe' people?

dialogue.content: じゃあ、そもそも企業選びが間違ってたのかな、、、
dialogue.English: If so, maybe I've been choosing the wrong companies from the start...

dialogue.content: 果たして本当にそうかどうかは、中に入ってみないとわからないのですが、あなたにふさわしい場所は絶対にあると思うのです。凄く
dialogue.English: Well, we can't know for sure without being on the inside, but I strongly believe there is a place that's right for you.

dialogue.content: 努力されていて、ご自分の事も理解されているので。
dialogue.English: You're so hardworking and you have such a good understanding of yourself.

dialogue.content: そうなんですか。たくさん受けてきましたが、このままやり続けるしかないんですかね。
dialogue.English: Really? I've applied to so many places... I guess I just have to keep going like this.

dialogue.content: 何が悪かったのか勇気を出して聞いてみるのも、現実を受け止める意味ではいいかと思います。
dialogue.English: It might be a good idea, in terms of accepting the reality of the situation, to gather your courage and ask them for feedback on what went wrong.

dialogue.content: きっと素晴らしい企業なら答えて下さるかと思うのですが
dialogue.English: I'd like to think that a truly great company would provide an answer.

dialogue.content: それはそうかもしれないですね。でも聞くのは怖いです
dialogue.English: That might be true. But it's scary to ask.

dialogue.content: それに
dialogue.English: Besides,

dialogue.content: 実際私も後で電話して聞いたことがありますから
dialogue.English: I've actually done that myself before—called them afterward to ask.

dialogue.content: 過去にも質問したことはありましたが、
dialogue.English: I have asked in the past, but...

dialogue.content: そうなのですね？
dialogue.English: Oh, you have?

dialogue.content: 採用不採用の理由は答えられませんって言われました、、、
dialogue.English: I was told, 'We cannot disclose the reasons for our hiring decisions.'

dialogue.content: 今後の自分の為に応えて欲しいですよね
dialogue.English: You just want them to answer for your own sake in the future, don't you?

dialogue.content: そうなんですけど、向こうも忙しいでしょうし
dialogue.English: I know, but they're probably busy,

dialogue.content: 正直落とした人間なんてどうでもいいなかなって思います。
dialogue.English: and honestly, I imagine they don't really care about the people they reject.

dialogue.content: そうですか！！悔しいですね！
dialogue.English: Is that so! That's so frustrating!

dialogue.content: そうですね。何をどうすればいいのかわからないです。
dialogue.English: Yes, it is. I don't know what to do anymore.

dialogue.content: いくつ面接受けられたのですか？
dialogue.English: How many interviews have you had?

dialogue.content: 正確にはわからないですが、
dialogue.English: I don't know the exact number, but...

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Mmmhmm.

dialogue.content: 20ぐらいは受けた気がする
dialogue.English: I think it's been about 20.

dialogue.content: おお！！２０！！それは心労が計り知れないですね。
dialogue.English: Wow! Twenty! The mental toll must be immense.

dialogue.content: はい。受けたところは全部しっかり調べて
dialogue.English: Yes. I researched every single company I applied to thoroughly,

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Mmmhmm.

dialogue.content: 適当にしたことは一回もないです
dialogue.English: I've never once done it half-heartedly.

dialogue.content: 適当にした人が受かって、でも、自分の思いは曲げずにこられたのでしょうね
dialogue.English: People who did it half-heartedly got offers, but you've come this far without compromising your principles, haven't you?

dialogue.content: だって普通適当にするのってよくないと思うんです。
dialogue.English: Because I just don't think it's right to be careless.

dialogue.content: 凄く頑張っておられる。
dialogue.English: You are working incredibly hard.

dialogue.content: 真面目に頑張らないと結果出ないと思うし
dialogue.English: I believe you can't get results unless you work hard and take it seriously.

dialogue.content: その通りです
dialogue.English: That's exactly right.

dialogue.content: 納得いかないと怒っておられるその気持ち大切です
dialogue.English: That feeling of anger, of it not being fair—that's an important feeling to hold onto.

dialogue.content: そうですね。でも流石に少し疲れてきました
dialogue.English: I suppose so. But I have to admit, I'm getting a little tired.

dialogue.content: 思いあたる節もないとのことですが
dialogue.English: You said you can't think of any particular reason, but...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Right.

dialogue.content: 家族の方は何とおっしゃってますか？
dialogue.English: What does your family say about it?

dialogue.content: 家族は特に何も言わないですね。こんなご時世だし頑張って探しなさいって
dialogue.English: My family doesn't say much. Just that 'times are tough, so do your best to keep looking.'

dialogue.content: 一人暮らしなので、あまり家族と会話もないですし
dialogue.English: I live by myself, so I don't really talk with my family that much anyway.

dialogue.content: そうですか。でもやはり、頑張って探しなさいと言われるのは、あなたの事を信じていらっしゃるからかと思ってしまいますよね
dialogue.English: I see. Still, when they tell you to 'keep trying your best,' I imagine it's because they believe in you.

dialogue.content: そうですね。家族ですもんね。
dialogue.English: I suppose so. They are my family, after all.

dialogue.content: こんなご時世ほんっと就職活動に苦労されていますが、あなたの頑張りを
dialogue.English: Job hunting is especially difficult in times like these, but...

dialogue.content: 求めている場所があなたの就職場所になると思うので
dialogue.English: the place that is looking for someone with your dedication is the place where you'll end up,

dialogue.content: あなたのトライも間違っていない事だけはお伝えさせて頂きたいです
dialogue.English: so I just want to tell you that what you're doing is not wrong.

dialogue.content: はい。自分でも頑張っているとは思います。
dialogue.English: Yes. I do think I'm working hard.

dialogue.content: たまの休息、挟めてますか？
dialogue.English: Are you managing to get some rest every now and then?

dialogue.content: まぁ時々息抜きはしてます。
dialogue.English: Well, I take a break from time to time.

dialogue.content: どんな息抜きをされているのですか？
dialogue.English: What do you do to unwind?

dialogue.content: 家でボーッとして、動画見たりとか、ちょっと出かけてみたりとか
dialogue.English: I'll just space out at home and watch some videos, or go out for a little while.

dialogue.content: いいですね！！
dialogue.English: That's nice!

dialogue.content: 息抜きしながらじゃないと続かないですからね。
dialogue.English: You can't keep going if you don't take breaks.

dialogue.content: そうですね！！頑張っておられるので、迷わずそのままで進んで頂きたいです。私がもし会社の社長なら即採用なのに！！
dialogue.English: That's so true! You're working so hard, so I want you to continue on your path without any doubt. If I were a company president, I'd hire you in a heartbeat!

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: すみません
dialogue.English: I'm sorry.

dialogue.content: こんな事しか・・・。時間になりました
dialogue.English: That's all I can really say... It looks like our time is up.

dialogue.content: はい。ありがとうございました！
dialogue.English: Okay. Thank you very much!

dialogue.content: 終了ボタンを押させてもらいますね
dialogue.English: I'm going to end the session now.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: はい。お疲れ様でした。本日はありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Okay. Thank you for your time today.
